added_findings.detail: S05b WP-03/04/05/06/08/09 apply anchored TV hunks to files other slices port WHOLE: SheetRecords, SheetModel__Shapes/Groups/TextAndDimensions and the facade (S03b WP-03/04); SheetChrome, ShapeGeometry, DimensionGeometry (S03b WP-06); MarkupBridge (S03b WP-07); ToolState and the hub State/PointerPress/PointerDrag/Keyboard/SheetTools/SheetTools__ContextMenu/HitResolution (S05a WP-08); Eyedropper, SelectionBox, EditScope (S05a WP-06); Measurements (S05a WP-07); KeyMap + key JSON incl. the rename (S05a WP-05); ToolSetup + AppConfig keys (S05a WP-04); PanelHost + Styles__Panels (S06a WP-02); Panel__Shapes / Panel__Dimensions (S06a WP-07, 1.8.1 fix in WP-01); Toolbar (S06a WP-10). Leaves are claimed two or three times: ShapeRings (S03b WP-02, S04b WP-01, S05b WP-01), DimensionRounding (S03b WP-02, S05b WP-01), Curves (S04b WP-01, S05b WP-01); the five drawing tools by S04b WP-07 and S05b WP-07; tests DimensionRoundUp / HatchLineControls by S03b, S06a and S05b. Dependency inversions: S03b WP-03 (TV SheetRecords:396 imports HatchPatterns) and WP-06 (TV SheetChrome:191 imports HatchPatterns and calls GradientTool DrawPdf with holes) need WP-S05b-01/V1 first; S05a WP-08 needs the whole 37 folder first (TV ToolState:133, PointerPress:195, PointerDrag:405, Keyboard:246, SheetTools:489, SheetTools__ContextMenu:206 import the adapter, which imports every unit); S06a WP-10 (Toolbar:207-208) needs 37 State/Setup; S06a WP-07 needs LineStyleTool 1.1.0; the ObjectSnap folder needs Curves and ShapeGeometry Rings/EdgePairs.

added_findings.title: Switch-on rules: register panel and toolbar only with the hub; ShapeTool and TV hubs load the whole 37 folder; Verify__Exports checks unreachable files
added_findings.detail: VV SheetTools__ToolState__.js:215 maps an unknown tool name to Select, so a Vector Tools panel or Circle / Arc button wired before the hub dispatch (S05a WP-08) silently picks Select. Baseline 01-Oct-2026: Exports PASS (415 files); ModuleGraph PASS (517 modules from 1 entry, follows dynamic import(), 1 known vendor issue).
added_findings.recommendation: Land the units inert in WP-S05b-V3 after their imports resolve; register the panel, add the toolbar buttons and land ShapeTool 1.10.0 only in WP-S05b-V4, the same release as S05a WP-08; run both verifiers after every batch.

notes: The survey is accurate on facts. I re-checked every critical and high finding (23 of 23) and most medium and low ones against the source. None was refuted. All 'VV lacks' claims hold: grep of all VVM found no equivalent under another name, and every VV-side line in the 11 shared files is older TV code. Version, devlog and line citations matched, the live VV bug (v2.106 Edges-off) is real, and the TV hatch-default defect and the config label misplacement are confirmed. Corrections: (1) the interim swap to VV Snapping cannot work for DimensionTool or ShapeTool, because VV Snapping exports no TARGET_*; (2) the ObjectSnap load-order trap also needs ShapeGeometry Rings/EdgePairs, IsLayerSelectable and GetSheetChrome; (3) a verbatim ShapeGeometry pulls in TV's Cloudflare ApiClient through 54 SheetImages Source (DIV-4); (4) TV Toolbar is 1.24.0; there are 15 ShapeHatch labels; VV CreateShape honours layerId; (5) ContextMenu flyouts and Measurements Say were missing prerequisites. The material problem is planning: six of the eleven work packages patch hunks into files that S03b, S05a and S06a port whole, and two of those slices depend on this one (S03b SheetRecords/SheetChrome import HatchPatterns; the S05a hub imports the whole 37 folder). I refuted WP-03/04/05/06/08/09 as standalone packages, added V1-V4 and an owner map with an integrated order (report section h), and added decisions D-S05b-V01 (one owner per file) and D-S05b-V02 (hatch packs and Patterns panel follow D-S04a-01). Watch: the switch-on must be one release across S05a and S05b; Verify__Exports checks unreachable files, so inert landings need resolvable imports; tests DimensionRoundUp and HatchLineControls are claimed by three slices. Not verified: no in-app or Node test runs; the 37 unit bodies were not traced end to end.
